en: Colorized vintage postcard showing traditional Dutch windmills along a waterside landscape. In the foreground is a large wooden windmill next to low buildings and greenery by a canal or river; another windmill stands in the distance on the opposite bank. The sky is pale yellow and blue, and there is printed caption text in the center bottom, with handwritten signatures or notes in ink.
